composition_summary: Preserved the single user message unchanged. Proposed one class-22 pure-logic PythonCode draft, pc-check-timeout-ms, using the target typed-inputs interface (inputs mapping, not guaranteed runtime support). The body reads timeout_ms with inputs.get, treats bool as invalid (not an integer), validates exact integer 0..7500 inclusive, and assigns result={valid, timeout_ms} on every outcome without exceptions or coercion. This is an unapproved draft; Q1, behavioral validation and human Q2 precede activation. No provider capabilities were observed; catalogue_revision and protocol_capabilities are null, so no provider-side prompt repair is justified.

payload.name: pc-check-timeout-ms
payload.description: Pure-logic guard: returns whether a raw timeout_ms candidate is a valid exact integer in 0..7500 inclusive. Booleans are rejected (not integers); missing, null and out-of-range values return valid=false with timeout_ms=null. No host calls, imports or I/O.

adjusted_volatile_messages: We need to validate raw timeout values before configuring a service.
